header.title: How to Replace a Light Ballast
header.description: This guide provides step-by-step instructions on how to diagnose and replace a faulty ballast in a fluorescent light fixture. Follow these instructions to safely restore your light to working order.

steps.description: Observe a fluorescent light to identify signs of a failing ballast, such as dimming and eventual failure to turn on.
actions: Observe the light source
Activate and shut off the light
Check for steady dimming
Observe if the light eventually won't come on
Observe if other aspects of the light device work less effectively

steps.description: This step instructs the user to diagnose the cause of a malfunctioning fluorescent or high-intensity light.
actions: Check the main power source for the house
See if the circuit breaker has been tripped
Check if a fuse has blown
Make sure the lamp is plugged into a functioning electrical outlet
Check for damage to the bulb itself
Rule out all causes before replacing the light ballast (if flickering)
steps.part: Circuit breaker, fuse, bulb, ballast, lamp

steps.description: This step instructs the user to check fluorescent bulbs for signs of wear, test their circuitry, and replace them if necessary, also noting proper disposal procedures.
actions: Check if the bulb is significantly dark and opaque at one end.
Test the circuit across the pins mounted in the end of each long fluorescent tube.
Determine if electrodes are functioning properly by checking for current flow between pins.
Replace the fluorescent tube if it has reached the end of its useful life.
Replace both fluorescent tubes in a pair if one fails.
Look up local laws regarding fluorescent bulb disposal.
Dispose of waste fluorescent bulbs properly.

steps.description: Determine whether to replace the entire fluorescent light fixture or just the ballast based on its age.
actions: Assess the age of the fluorescent light fixture.
If fixture is older than 15 years, consider replacing the entire fixture.
If fixture is less than 5 years old, consider replacing the ballast.

steps.description: This step involves locating, removing, and replacing the ballast within a fluorescent light fixture.
actions: Disassemble the fluorescent light fixture
Find the ballast (a small metal box with colored wires)
Examine the circuit diagram inside the light housing
Detach the circuit diagram
Purchase a magnetic or electronic ballast (matching the old one)
Install the new ballast according to the diagram
